assertions.description: The HTMLMenuBarElement interface is exposed on Window.
The HTMLMenuListElement interface is exposed on Window.
The HTMLMenuItemElement interface is exposed on Window.
The HTMLSubMenuElement interface is exposed on Window.
document.createElement('menuitem') produces a real HTMLMenuItemElement (not HTMLUnknownElement) carrying the disabled, checked, and defaultChecked IDL members.
assertions.test: (()=>{const e=document.createElement('menuitem');return !(e instanceof HTMLUnknownElement)&&'disabled' in e&&'checked' in e&&'defaultChecked' in e;})()

assertions.description: HTMLMenuItemElement includes CommandInvokerElement: menuitem exposes command and commandForElement so it can invoke sub-menulists.
assertions.test: (()=>{const e=document.createElement('menuitem');return !(e instanceof HTMLUnknownElement)&&'command' in e&&'commandForElement' in e;})()

assertions.description: A connected menulist behaves as an implicit popover=auto without any popover attribute: showPopover() succeeds and :popover-open matches; on browsers without the feature the same call throws NotSupportedError, which fails this assertion honestly.
The defaultchecked content attribute reflects as defaultChecked and seeds the live checked state of a menuitem inside a checkable fieldset in a menulist.
assertions.test: (()=>{const ml=document.createElement('menulist');if(ml instanceof HTMLUnknownElement)return false;ml.innerHTML='<fieldset checkable="single"><menuitem id="cnf-a" defaultchecked>A</menuitem><menuitem id="cnf-b">B</menuitem></fieldset>';document.body.appendChild(ml);try{const a=ml.querySelector('#cnf-a');return a.defaultChecked===true&&a.checked===true;}finally{ml.remove();}})()

assertions.description: In a fieldset checkable=single, programmatically checking one menuitem unchecks the previously checked sibling (menuitemradio exclusivity).
assertions.test: (()=>{const ml=document.createElement('menulist');if(ml instanceof HTMLUnknownElement)return false;ml.innerHTML='<fieldset checkable="single"><menuitem id="cnf-x" defaultchecked>X</menuitem><menuitem id="cnf-y">Y</menuitem></fieldset>';document.body.appendChild(ml);try{const x=ml.querySelector('#cnf-x'),y=ml.querySelector('#cnf-y');if(!('checked' in y))return false;y.checked=true;return y.checked===true&&x.checked===false;}finally{ml.remove();}})()
